get.description: Answers while the process is up. Checks no dependencies and needs no auth.
200 when Postgres and Redis both answer, 503 otherwise. Needs no auth.

post.description: Create a User and return their profile. Needs no auth.

Exchange an email and password for a short-lived access token and a refresh
token, starting a new session. Needs no auth.

Swap a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token; the one sent
stops working. Reusing an old one ends every session of its User. Needs no auth.

End the session the refresh token belongs to, so none of its refresh tokens work
again. The access token still works until it expires.

get.description: The profile of the User the bearer token names.
All the User's Events, newest first, each with its state on their local today.

post.description: Create the User's Event and its first Plan, and return the Event's detail.

get.description: One of the User's Events, with its state, countdown and Current Plan version.
The Event's Current Plan: Milestones in order, each with its Tasks by Plan Day.
What to do today: "Day N of M" and the Current Plan's Tasks on local today.

post.description: Abandon the User's Active Event so they can create another. It stays readable.

get.description:
A Vocab Task's batch of Vocab Items, in order. The first call fixes it; later
calls return the same batch. Opening a Task introduces nothing.

post.description:
Complete a Vocab Task, introducing its batch: each item is first due for Review
the next day. Completing it again changes nothing. A Listen Task is completed by
answering its questions instead.

get.description:
A Listen Task's Listen Dialogue and Comprehension Questions, with the answers
given so far. The first call fixes the dialogue; later calls return the same one.
A question's correct option is sent only once it's answered.

post.description:
Answer one of a Listen Task's Comprehension Questions, for good: the result says
whether it was right and which option was. The third answer completes the Task.

get.description:
The Review Queue: the Vocab Items due on local today or earlier, oldest first.
Empty on the Event Day and for a Past Event.

post.description:
Grade one of today's Reviews: again, hard, good or easy. Returns the item's next
due date, null once nothing more is scheduled before the Event Day.

DueReview.title: DueReview
DueReview.description: One Vocab Item in the Review Queue: due on `due_on`, today or earlier.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: One specific problem, such as a field that failed validation.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The body of every 4xx and 5xx response.

EventCreate.title: EventCreate
EventCreate.description:
What a User sends to create an Event. The Event Day must be 3 to 60 days after
their local today, which the Event service checks.

EventDetail.title: EventDetail
EventDetail.description: An Event with its state, countdown and Current Plan version, on local today.

EventState.title: EventState
EventState.description:
Where an Event stands on the User's local today (ADR 0005).

`active` and `event_day` both make it the User's Active Event; `past` means its
Event Day has gone by or it was abandoned.

EventSummary.title: EventSummary
EventSummary.description: An Event as listed: what it is, when, and its state on local today.

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: The kind of Event. It decides which Scenarios are available.

GivenAnswer.title: GivenAnswer
GivenAnswer.description: The User's answer to a Comprehension Question, now that it's final.

Grade.title: Grade
Grade.description: The User's four buttons on a Review. Only Again counts as forgotten.

Level.title: Level
Level.description: The User's proficiency in the Event's target language (a trimmed CEFR scale).

ListenAnswerCreate.title: ListenAnswerCreate
ListenAnswerCreate.description: An answer to one Comprehension Question: its number and the chosen option's.

ListenAnswerResult.title: ListenAnswerResult
ListenAnswerResult.description:
Whether the answer was right, the correct option, and the Task's status: the
third answer completes it.

ListenLine.title: ListenLine
ListenLine.description: One line of the Listen Dialogue: who says it, and what they say.

ListenQuestion.title: ListenQuestion
ListenQuestion.description:
A Comprehension Question with its three options. `answer` is null until the User
answers it, so the correct option is never sent before then.

ListenTask.title: ListenTask
ListenTask.description:
A Listen Task's Listen Dialogue and its three Comprehension Questions.

The dialogue is fixed the first time the Task is opened or answered, so it's the
same every time. `answerable` is true only while the questions can still be
answered: on the Task's own Plan Day, while the Event is Active and the Task isn't
complete. A Missed Task, a later Plan Day's, or a Past Event's is read-only.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: What a person sends to log in.

PlanDay.title: PlanDay
PlanDay.description: A Milestone's Tasks on one Plan Day, in position order.

PlanDetail.title: PlanDetail
PlanDetail.description: An Event's Current Plan: its Milestones in order, each with Tasks by Plan Day.

PlanMilestone.title: PlanMilestone
PlanMilestone.description:
A Scenario scheduled in the Plan. Its title and difficulty come from the Scenario
Catalog (ADR 0003).

PlanTask.title: PlanTask
PlanTask.description: One Task in a Plan, with its status on the User's local today.

RefreshTokenRequest.title: RefreshTokenRequest
RefreshTokenRequest.description: A refresh token, sent to `/auth/refresh` to rotate it or `/auth/logout` to revoke it.

ReviewGrade.title: ReviewGrade
ReviewGrade.description: What a User sends to grade one of today's Reviews.

ReviewQueue.title: ReviewQueue
ReviewQueue.description:
The Vocab Items due for Review on the User's local today or earlier, oldest
first. Empty on the Event Day and for a Past Event.

ReviewResult.title: ReviewResult
ReviewResult.description:
A graded item's next due date: null once nothing more is scheduled before the
Event Day.

TaskCompletion.title: TaskCompletion
TaskCompletion.description:
A completed Task's status, and how many Vocab Items it introduced.

The same every time it's completed: a repeat changes nothing.

TaskKind.title: TaskKind
TaskKind.description: What a Task asks of the User: learn Vocab Items, listen to a dialogue, or speak.

TaskStatus.title: TaskStatus
TaskStatus.description: Where a Task stands on the User's local today.

TodayDetail.title: TodayDetail
TodayDetail.description:
What a User does today for an Event: "Day N of M" and today's Tasks in order.

On the Event Day and for a Past Event there's no Plan Day: `plan_day` is null and
`tasks` is empty.

TodayTask.title: TodayTask
TodayTask.description: One of today's Tasks, with its Milestone's Scenario title and its status.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
A short-lived access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`, and
the refresh token that gets the next one from `/auth/refresh` (ADR 0007).

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description: What a person sends to register.

UserRead.title: UserRead
UserRead.description: A User's profile. It never carries the password hash.

VocabBatch.title: VocabBatch
VocabBatch.description:
A Vocab Task's batch, in order. Fixed the first time the Task is opened or
completed, so it's the same every time. It's shorter than the Task's
`vocab_batch_size`, possibly empty, when its Scenario has run out of items.

VocabBatchItem.title: VocabBatchItem
VocabBatchItem.description: One Vocab Item in a Vocab Task's batch, with its English translation.
